title: Pi adapter integration tests
summary: Exercise real Pi adapter registrations, commands, lifecycle hooks, and resume behavior.
description: Build a Pi adapter test host that loads the actual extension entrypoint, records registered tools/commands, supplies a controlled UI/session/event context, and uses a real PlanStore backed by a temporary `.planner`. Cover extension registration, disabled-by-default startup, `/planner load`, `/planner stop`, planner-web status, before_agent_start initialization, task start/update/complete, phase/feature mutations, requirements, handoff proposal and confirmed write, repair, cleanup, recap/resume injection, and message_end behavior. Mock only the Pi host boundary; do not mock core persistence or adapter business logic. Add at least one subprocess smoke test using the real Pi CLI when the environment supports it, with deterministic fallback reporting when the interactive terminal is unavailable.

tasks.title: Test Pi startup, load, stop, and web lifecycle
tasks.description:
Verify extension registration and startup behavior with planner disabled by default, then invoke `/planner load`, `/planner stop`, aliases, planner-web status, and repeated load/stop cycles. Exercise session_start and before_agent_start initialization, dynamic LAN server handling, context cache invalidation, non-blocking notifications, and safe cleanup. Assert no startup prompt blocks the host and that load/stop state is reflected in subsequent tool behavior.

---
**Completion summary:**
T241 — Pi startup/load/stop/web lifecycle tests landed, plus a real bug found & fixed.

NEW FILE: packages/pi-adapter/test/web-lifecycle.test.mjs — 4 tests on top of the T240 host harness:
1. startup: planner disabled by default, no blocking prompt (0 input/confirm/select calls), no context injection, planner-web reports running:false.
2. aliases: /planner load enables + recap trigger; /planner stop halts (notify + running:false + injection disabled); the `disable` alias behaves identically; unknown subcommand → "Unknown" warning.
3. repeated cycles: second load is idempotent (no second "Starting web server" notify, same URL, second recap trigger); after stop a third load starts a fresh live server (health check); planner-web tool start/stop drives the same state; after tool-stop the hook stays enabled and the next block shows "Web UI: not running".
4. context cache invalidation: recap turn shows URL + STARTUP RESUME PROTOCOL; steady turn is a cache hit (no protocol, URL kept); task_start through the adapter invalidates the cache (block shows "in-progress tasks: P001(F001)/T001 — Implement login"); tool-level stop invalidates it (block must NOT claim WEB UI RUNNING — regression guard); tool-level start restores URL; command stop disables injection (undefined); reload restores URL.

BUG FIX (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts): stopServer() did not invalidate the before_agent_start context cache (contextBlockDirty stayed false), so after /planner stop or planner-web stop the fast path would keep serving a cached block claiming "🌐 WEB UI RUNNING: http://...". Added `contextBlockDirty = true;` in stopServer() — all stop paths (stop/disable command, planner-web tool, planner-stop tool, session_shutdown) funnel through it. Test 4's tool-stop assertion is the regression guard.

VERIFICATION: pi-adapter suite 30/30 (ref-validation 16 + host harness 5 + web lifecycle 4 + …); full pnpm test 339/339 twice, [test-all] OK, coverage 76.6-76.8 / 73.5 / 76.3-76.7 above baseline (68/72/75). No commits/pushes (working tree only).

tasks.title: Test Pi mutations, validation, requirements, and handoffs
tasks.description:
Invoke real Pi adapter tools for feature/phase/task/requirement creation and updates, invalid and missing fields, references, checklist/reorder operations, task completion rollup, linked requirements, handoff preparation, explicit target confirmation, archive/read/clear, and repair. Assert UI notifications and tool responses use composite IDs, rejected writes leave files unchanged, and terminal phases cannot receive new handoffs.

---
**Completion summary:**
T242 — Pi mutations/validation/requirements/handoffs tests landed, with THREE real adapter bugs found & fixed.

NEW FILE: packages/pi-adapter/test/mutations.test.mjs — 7 tests:
1. creation round-trip feature→phase→task→requirement with composite IDs (F002/P002/T002, requirement link verified in real store).
2. invalid writes rejected, files unchanged: bogus status → "Update failed" (schema), restrictive status without motivation → rejected, missing/invalid refs handled, handoff empty/generic text rejected; valid motivation then writes statusLog.
3. lifecycle + rollup: task_start (response carries composite ref via phase context), task_complete gated by unchecked checklist, force-complete rolls phase AND feature to done.
4. checklist add/toggle/remove + priority reorder.
5. requirements create+link+update.
6. handoffs: proposal (confirmationRequired), confirmed write, list/show, clear with archive file, done-phase rejection (PlanStoreError).
7. plan_repair healthy integrity report.

BUG FIXES in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:
- task_update TOOL did not enforce needsMotivation (MCP adapter and /planner task update command do; the tool's own description claims motivation is REQUIRED). Now rejects "planned → blocked" without motivation — AGENTS.md rule 8 parity.
- startServer only retried EADDRINUSE/EACCES/EADDRNOTAVAIL; under heavy load serve() can fail differently and /planner load silently ended with no server ("Web UI: not running" in the recap). Now retries any listen failure once on a random free port (port 0).
- startServer did NOT invalidate the before_agent_start context cache: after stop→prompt→tool-start, the next prompt served the stale cached "Web UI: not running" block. Added contextBlockDirty=true in startServer (mirror of the stopServer fix in T241).

FLAKE ELIMINATION: the web-lifecycle context-cache test flaked ~1-in-6 under concurrent full-suite load (startServer EADDRINUSE race on the 3030-3999 scan + stale cache). Root-caused with a deterministic concurrent repro (2× probe sequences / 2× full unit suites); after the fixes: 12/12 concurrent full unit suites clean, probe 10/10, full pnpm test 346/346 twice with [test-all] OK.

Coverage baseline re-derived again (test/coverage.config.mjs): unit/all → lines 79, functions 77, branches 72 (floors of 12+ samples; report.test.mjs hardcoded threshold updated to 79). Final run: 79.29/72.83/77.88. No commits/pushes (working tree only).

---
**Completion summary:**
Independent review approved after rework. Pi adapter mutation tests now snapshot phase JSON bytes around each rejected mutation and verify a valid write changes bytes; startServer retries once with port 0 after any startup failure, with a busy-port fallback test. Personally verified 8/8 targeted, `pnpm check`, and full `pnpm test` 347/347. No commit/push.

tasks.title: Reject no-op feature updates with explicit outcome
tasks.description:
packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3128 feature_update accepts every mutable field as optional and reports success after updateFeatures even when an upstream tool payload drops the intended description. A ~45k-character description can fail to reach the tool while a smaller ~27k payload persists, leaving only featureId and producing a misleading success response. Add an explicit outcome contract: when no mutable field is received, return `Not updated` with the reason and do not write/update timestamps. For received fields, report the persisted mutation deterministically so callers can distinguish a successful write from a rejected/no-op update. Add a Pi host regression test that invokes feature_update with only a feature ref and proves the response, feature JSON bytes, and updatedAt remain unchanged; preserve existing human ref resolution for F00x/shortId/UUID/name and existing successful updates. Scope this task to the Pi adapter response path; do not add chunked writes unless separately authorized.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented Pi feature_update outcome contract: fieldless payload returns `Not updated` with explicit payload-limit/no-write reason and preserves planner data; successful updates list exactly the received fields saved. Added a byte-for-byte feature-file regression test proving no-op calls leave JSON and updatedAt unchanged, plus saved-fields coverage for a valid F001 update. Verified `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build`, targeted 18/18, `pnpm check`, and full `pnpm test` 351/351. No commit/push.

tasks.title: Fix Pi nested command argument completions
tasks.description:
Regression coverage for Pi’s `/planner` interactive command surface. In `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `getArgumentCompletions` currently falls back to all static command suggestions when the input includes an entity ref after a valid nested command (for example `/planner feature update F001`). Pi then selects `init` and can overwrite the typed argument. Preserve suggestions while a command path is incomplete, but once a known command path is followed by whitespace/arguments, return no fallback suggestion so arbitrary human refs survive. Add a real Pi host regression in `packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs` or a focused command test, simulating `/planner feature update F001` with controlled UI inputs; verify the intended feature is selected and no fallback command is invoked. Preserve completion behavior for command discovery and do not change tool APIs or planner data semantics.

---
**Completion summary:**
Fixed Pi `/planner` nested-command completions in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`: once a complete known command is followed by whitespace, completion returns no fallback menu, preserving free-form human refs/titles such as `feature update F001` instead of allowing Pi to select `init`. Added a real Pi host regression in `packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs` that asserts no completion is returned for `feature update F001`, the command resolves F001 without a picker, and it updates that feature. Verified adapter build, targeted 10/10 host tests, `pnpm check`, and full `pnpm test` 354/354. No commit/push.

---
**Completion summary:**
Corrected the Pi completion API contract in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:2432`: complete nested command paths followed by an argument now return `null`, suppressing Pi’s global fallback menu rather than returning `[]`. Updated the T278 regression in `packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs:204` to require `null` while still exercising `feature update F001` without a picker. Verified: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build`; `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter check`; `node --test packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs` (10/10). Changes remain uncommitted on `next`; pre-existing working-tree changes were left untouched.

---

Reopened after user validation exposed the actual defect: the session-start `ctx.ui.addAutocompleteProvider` wrapper in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:834`, not only `getArgumentCompletions`, always replaced unmatched nested-command input with the full planner menu. Centralized the complete-command-plus-argument detection in `hasPlannerCommandArgument` (`index.ts:157`) and made both completion paths return `null` when an arbitrary argument follows a known command. Extended `packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs:199` to instantiate the registered session-start autocomplete wrapper itself and verify real TUI-path suppression for feature refs, checklist parameters, and handoff phase refs; it also executes `feature update F001` against the real PlanStore. Verified: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build`; `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter check`; `node --test packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs` (10/10). No commit/push; unrelated existing worktree changes were left untouched.

tasks.title: Cancel Pi interactive planner workflows with Escape
tasks.description:
`packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` implements multi-step interactive `/planner` workflows with `ctx.ui.input`, `ctx.ui.editor`, `ctx.ui.select`, and `ctx.ui.confirm`. In the current feature update flow around `index.ts:1577`, cancellation returns `undefined`, but the handler continues to later prompts and eventually persists partial changes. Implement an all-or-nothing cancellation policy: escaping at any interactive step exits the entire command before PlanStore writes or generated-view writes. Apply the shared pattern across creation, update, discuss, destructive-confirmation, and handoff flows while retaining valid optional-field semantics (empty submitted values are distinct from cancellation). Extend `packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs`, which loads the actual extension against a real temporary PlanStore, to verify no persistence occurs when a flow is cancelled at representative early/middle/late steps. Preserve Pi’s native global `app.interrupt` behavior; do not replace its keybinding or introduce a global terminal-key interceptor.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented transactional Escape cancellation for interactive Pi `/planner` commands. `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:1073` now wraps `ctx.ui.input`, `editor`, and `select`: `undefined`/`null` from Pi (Escape/cancel) aborts the whole command and emits `Cancelled — no changes saved.` before later prompts or persistence. Empty submitted strings remain valid optional-field values. Deferred Phase `discuss` persistence until its question series completes; moved Phase/Task create follow-up prompts before entity persistence; reset initialization now collects replacement metadata before deletion; project discovery defers codebase/language normalization persistence until after all prompts. `packages/pi-adapter/test/helpers/pi-host-fixture.mjs` now supports queued editor responses; `packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs` validates no partial feature update, phase discovery change, handoff write, or task creation after Escape. Verified: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build`; `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter check`; `node --test packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs` (11/11 passing). No commit/push; all unrelated worktree changes left untouched.

tasks.title: Publish verified next prerelease
tasks.description:
Prepare the currently verified Agent Plan worktree for the `next` prerelease channel. `scripts/release-next.cjs` is the canonical next-channel release script: it reads the shared public-package prerelease version from `packages/plan-core/package.json`, increments the `-next.N` counter, updates only the five public packages listed in its PACKAGES array (`@agent-plan/core`, `@agent-plan/mcp`, `@agent-plan/server`, `agent-plan`, `@agent-plan/pi-adapter`), runs `pnpm install`, `pnpm -r build`, and `pnpm check`, then stages all current worktree changes, commits, and pushes `next`. `packages/plan-web-ui/package.json` is private and deliberately excluded from npm versioning/publishing. Current public versions are all `0.2.19-next.20`, so the target is `0.2.19-next.21`; the `next` push triggers `.github/workflows/publish.yml` to publish the five packages under npm dist-tag `next`. User explicitly authorized this commit/push/release action.
